name: Lightbox
summary: A modal collection media viewer with keyboard and swipe navigation.

useWhen: Viewing a selected media item in a modal

obligations: Contain focus in the modal and restore it on close.

behavior: Closed content is not rendered and an empty collection never opens.
Missing default selection resolves to the first valid item and removed selections are invalidated.
Arrow keys and swipes navigate the selected item in document direction.
accessibility: The popup is a focus-contained modal dialog named from the selected item unless explicitly labelled.

requirements.reason: Native colors do not apply to web React.
Native font metrics do not apply to web React.
